summary.zh-Hans: 莱特纳公园有林荫步道，从部分路段可眺望伏尔塔瓦河及河上的桥梁。
summary.en: Letná Park has tree-shaded promenades, with views of the Vltava and its bridges from parts of the paths.

names.zh-Hans: 国家技术博物馆交通展厅

summary.zh-Hans: 布拉格国家技术博物馆交通展厅展示汽车、摩托车和铁路车辆等交通技术，飞机悬挂在展厅上方。
summary.en: The transport hall at Prague’s National Technical Museum displays cars, motorcycles and railway technology, with aircraft suspended above the hall.

summary.zh-Hans: Chlebíčky 在小片白面包上铺配料，可有火腿、奶酪、腌菜、蛋和蛋黄酱等，在布拉格可以买到。
summary.en: Chlebíčky are small open-faced white-bread sandwiches with toppings such as ham, cheese, pickled vegetables, egg and mayonnaise, sold in Prague.

summary.zh-Hans: 这道捷克菜将牛肉与根茎蔬菜烹制，配奶油酱汁，通常搭配面包团子或卡罗维发利团子。
summary.en: This Czech dish pairs beef cooked with root vegetables with a creamy sauce, typically served with bread or Carlsbad dumplings.
